Context: 5. Procedure Minor Penalties.-

- (ii) The CVC Circular 8/12/14 of 3rd December, 2014 stipulates that all such cases where the DA proposes to take any action on variance with the Commission's first stage advice would continue to be referred to the eve for obtaining second stage advice. In this regard, CVC clarified that the above circular applies only to the disciplinary cases of non-Presidential appointees including officials of CPSEs, Public Sector Banks and Autonomous Bodies, etc. The above instructions, do not apply to the Group 'A'
